title: Rookie QB Cole Payton gave the Eagles' offense some life in listless preseason opener

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rookie QB Cole Payton gave the Eagles' offense some life in listless preseason opener
sources.description: The Eagles' offense didn't play its starters in the preseason opener, and the backups couldn't move the ball much — until fourth-string rookie quarterback Cole Payton entered the game in the fourth quarter.
